# Maarifasasa

> Pan-African workforce development company training 1 million young Africans in digital skills and connecting them to global earning opportunities by 2030.

Maarifasasa offers bootcamps, certificate programs, the Talent Accelerator, the Digital Field Agents program, an AI Pathway Advisor, and an affiliate program. Headquartered in Lira, Uganda.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of programs and the learn-to-earn mission.
- [About](/about): Mission, founder story, and Pan-African vision.
- [Programs](/programs): Digital Field Agents, 10X Programme with WITU, and Agency Programme.
- [Learning](/learning): Talent Accelerator, Bootcamps, and Certificate Programs.
- [Courses](/courses): Catalogue of available courses.
- [Learn & Earn](/learn-and-earn): How learners earn while studying.
- [AI Pathway Advisor](/advisor): Personalized career pathway recommendations.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on digital skills, careers, and success stories.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch for training or partnerships.
